findings.name: Frechet Audio Distance: A Metric for Evaluating Music Enhancement Algorithms
findings.claim: Magnitude L2 correlated -0.01 and cosine -0.15 with human ratings; FAD 0.52.
findings.design_implication: Never surface log-mel L1/L2 as a quality number; label it a deviation diagnostic.

findings.name: Correlation of Frechet Audio Distance With Human Perception of Environmental Audio Is Embedding Dependant
findings.claim: FAD's human agreement exceeds Spearman 0.5 with PANNs-WGM-LogMel and falls below 0.1 with VGGish.
findings.design_implication: If FAD ever ships, pin and name the embedding.

findings.name: A Survey on Evaluation Metrics for Music Generation
findings.claim: FAD is distributional and needs large reference sets; CLAP measures prompt relevance; both align poorly with human preference.
findings.design_implication: Exclude FAD and CLAP from any single-take tool.

findings.name: mir_eval: A Transparent Implementation of Common MIR Metrics
findings.claim: mir_eval defaults encode 50 ms onset and 50 cent pitch tolerance.
findings.design_implication: The 40 ms gate is stricter than convention; report the 50 ms figure alongside.

findings.name: Maximum Filter Vibrato Suppression for Onset Detection
findings.claim: SuperFlux's maximum filter over spectral trajectories cuts onset false positives up to 60% on vibrato-heavy material.
findings.design_implication: Use SuperFlux, not plain spectral flux, on the singing route.

findings.name: Chirp Group Delay based Onset Detection in Instruments with Fast Attack
findings.claim: SOTA onset detection sits near F1 0.88 across datasets; SuperFlux and CNN detectors perform comparably.
findings.design_implication: Audio-derived onset error ships with a detector-confidence caveat and never overrides the MIDI-truth gate.

findings.name: SwiftF0: Fast and Accurate Monophonic Pitch Detection
findings.claim: SwiftF0 operates on the magnitude spectrogram, 91.8% harmonic mean at 10 dB SNR, 95,842 params, ~42x CREPE CPU speed.
findings.design_implication: A spectrogram-derived pitch is legitimate when a trained model reads it; peak-picking a mel plot is not a substitute.

findings.name: RMVPE: A Robust Model for Vocal Pitch Estimation in Polyphonic Music
findings.claim: RMVPE extracts vocal pitch from polyphonic mixes without separation, stable across SNR.
findings.design_implication: Route pitch through RMVPE when the reference is a produced mix.

findings.name: Pitch-and-Spectrum-Aware Singing Quality Assessment with Bias Correction and Model Fusion
findings.claim: The winning VoiceMOS 2024 singing predictor reaches utterance-level SRCC 0.639 (system-level 0.888).
findings.design_implication: Aggregate across takes before any comparative claim.

findings.name: Liquid Haskell refinement types tutorial
findings.claim: Contracts must hold or the program is rejected; soft wishes are not types — analog for MIDI+lyric hard Spec.
findings.design_implication: Hard refinement analog hold-with-limit.

findings.name: Mix voice / muscular antagonism lexicon
findings.claim: Chest=M1 (TA-led), head=M2 (CT-led), mix=co-contraction — named mechanisms, not F0 labels. Hold-with-limit for register language.
findings.design_implication: Pedagogy hold-with-limit; not DiffSinger tension scalar.

findings.name: Liquid Haskell Tutorial 01 Introduction
findings.claim: Refinement-type intro: rejected programs fail contracts — maps to score-lock as Spec input.
findings.design_implication: Hard-contract pedagogy for SVS inputs.

findings.name: Muscular antagonism lexicon
findings.claim: TA/CT antagonism framing for mix — register as glottal coordination language.
findings.design_implication: Pedagogy hold-with-limit.

findings.name: EMP Soft Constraints
findings.claim: Soft = penalty in objective; hard = feasibility — names CFG/style as soft vs note/lyric lock as hard.
findings.design_implication: Soft vs hard formulation hold-with-limit.

findings.name: Progressive disclosure of named cockpit controls
findings.claim: Expose register/formant when the engine has them; hide false enums — HCI analog for not inventing register menus on DiffSinger/OpenUtau/WORLD.
findings.design_implication: HCI hold-with-limit.

findings.name: ITU-R BS.1534-3 MUSHRA
findings.claim: Hidden reference and mid-range anchors are listener-screening tools; exclude listeners who mis-rate them on >15% of items.
findings.design_implication: Reuse the composition-panel discrimination floor; do not invent a speech-MOS gate.

findings.name: XiaoiceSing
findings.claim: Canonical SVS tests split pronunciation MOS from quality; F0 RMSE 10.45 Hz, Dur RMSE 20.55, F0 CORR 0.99.
findings.design_implication: A single naturalness MOS hides off-key or unintelligible singing.

findings.name: Sinsy
findings.claim: Without pitch-normalization to the score, F0-RMSE jumps from ~74 to 264 cents.
findings.design_implication: Score-relative F0 error in cents is the pitch admission metric.

findings.name: VocalRender
findings.claim: Objective RPA/IOU can invert subjective score-following; VocalRender won MS-MOS 2.96 while SoulX-Singer won RPA.
findings.design_implication: Do not admit a vocal on RPA/MCD alone; CMOS vs a human hidden reference is the perceptual check.

findings.name: AI singing coach metacognition RCT
findings.claim: LLM singing-coach raised metacognition, not singing scores; the AI was a chatbot plus teacher-demo, not a synthetic singer.
findings.design_implication: Coaching-layer evidence does not license a model-as-singer.
findings.authors: Li, Cui, Manoharan, Dai, Liu & Huang

findings.name: Singing with yourself
findings.claim: Poor-pitch singers match themselves far better than other voices; a perfect other singer is the hard case.
findings.design_implication: A high-MOS synth of a different identity is a worse pitch-matching model than the learner's own voice.

findings.name: GLSL Uniform (named params)
findings.claim: Named uniforms vs opaque handles analog for formant/register knobs vs opaque mgc/BAP. Verifier: Cloudflare 403 / fetch timeout — leave unverified.
findings.design_implication: Flag GLSL 403 unverified; do not land as verified.

findings.name: Score-based / Werktreue pedagogy (ch7)
findings.claim: Execute the written map vs invent within style — practice-companion as score-instrument.
findings.design_implication: Werktreue analog hold-with-limit.

findings.name: GLSL Opaque Type
findings.claim: Opaque types cannot live in uniform blocks — analog for opaque spectral streams. Verifier: 403/timeout — leave unverified.
findings.design_implication: Flag GLSL 403 unverified.

findings.name: Improvisation and Teaching (adjacent pedagogy)
findings.claim: Improvisation pedagogy adjacent to score-based learning — soft rails after hard lock.
findings.design_implication: Pedagogy adjacent hold-with-limit.

findings.name: Constraint-based jazz improvisation pedagogy
findings.claim: Rhythmic/harmonic constraints as generative soft rails — partial hold after hard pitch/lyric lock.
findings.design_implication: Jazz soft-after-hard hold-with-limit.

findings.name: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) as soft conditioning
findings.claim: Guidance scale steers but never guarantees the condition. Verifier: fail-transfer as score-lock substitute — raising CFG cannot force MIDI+lyrics honor.
findings.design_implication: Flag CFG-as-lock fail-transfer; leave unverified as lock.
